home_scope: Established Ile-de-France boundary matching province-stage PRS history on 1936.1.2.1. Only actually owned and fully controlled home states qualify in either campaign phase; excludes Brittany and every other province.

simp_chinese.SFP_devalue_the_franc_desc: 将市区与近郊的税收、工资和采购纳入同一清算制度，让法兰西岛的工场能够依靠稳定订单恢复生产。保留财政改革收益及财政内阁解锁。
simp_chinese.SFP_autoroutes_desc: 修整巴黎市区与近郊之间的运输道路。在本省完整掌握的州提升1级基础设施；符合条件的道路均已完备时，转为40政治点数。
simp_chinese.SFP_invest_in_the_metropole_desc: 把市政财政用于公共服务、街区修缮和工场恢复，协调巴黎与近郊的建设预算。获得5%稳定度。
simp_chinese.SFP_metropolitan_france_desc: 清理巴黎本土的闲置仓库与旧工场，为本省新增2个建筑槽。此项用地整理不依赖其他大区。
simp_chinese.SFP_algerie_france_desc: 整理法兰西岛近郊的生产用地，将地方预算用于本省工场，新增2个建筑槽。
simp_chinese.SFP_invest_in_the_colonies_desc: 将巴黎市区与近郊的公共工程纳入同一预算。在本省完整掌握的州建设1座民用工厂并增加1个建筑槽；容量已满时转为1次100%工业研究加成。合作改善仅适用于本省符合条件的州。
simp_chinese.SFP_invest_in_west_africa_desc: 统筹塞纳河沿岸的仓储、旧车间和工场用地，把三项用地准备集中用于巴黎本土。为法兰西岛新增合计6个建筑槽。
simp_chinese.SFP_invest_in_syria_desc: 整备法兰西岛本土的工场用地，新增2个建筑槽。
simp_chinese.SFP_invest_in_indochina_desc: 整理法兰西岛本土的旧车间，新增2个建筑槽。
simp_chinese.SFP_industrial_expansion_desc: 利用首都工程师、熟练工人和采购市场扩建本省制造业。在法兰西岛增加2个建筑槽并建设2座民用工厂；保留原容量限制与财政补助。
simp_chinese.SFP_colonial_industry_desc: 把市区订单与本省近郊工场接入同一生产计划。在法兰西岛增加1个建筑槽并建设1座民用工厂；保留原容量限制与财政补助。
simp_chinese.SFP_military_factories_desc: 以巴黎本土的工程与制造能力扩建兵工。在法兰西岛新增合计4个建筑槽并建设2座军用工厂；保留原容量限制与财政补助。
simp_chinese.SFP_extra_research_slot_desc: 依托巴黎大学和工程学校集中开展应用研究。完整拥有并控制巴黎市区，拥有至少6座工厂与2个研究槽后，可获得第3研究槽；槽位已达上限时转为1次100%电子研究加成。
simp_chinese.SFP_extra_research_slot_2_desc: 将法兰西岛的实验室与制造企业组成常设科研联合所。完整掌握巴黎市区、至少12座工厂和3个研究槽，并完成前项研究扩展后，可获得第4研究槽；槽位已达上限时转为1次100%电子研究加成。
simp_chinese.SFP_global_integration_desc: 统一巴黎市区与本省近郊的税收、公共采购和生产安排，让既有工场形成持续协作。落实首都统筹预算精神。
simp_chinese.SFP_begin_rearmament_desc: 向巴黎本土工场下达统一军备订单，恢复本省兵工生产。建设与用地收益均落在完整掌握的法兰西岛州，保留原容量限制和补助。
simp_chinese.SFP_alpine_forts_desc: 统筹有序作战、工事建设与首都要地守备。在本省符合条件的州建设要塞，保留原陆军学说减免、防御精神、建设上限与财政补助。
simp_chinese.SFP_extend_the_maginot_line_desc: 以首都要地防御为基础，完善法兰西岛市区与近郊的防御纵深。要塞建设限定在本省完整掌握的州，保留原上限与财政补助。
simp_chinese.SFP_air_focus_desc: 整备本省机场、飞行训练和维修勤务，建立保护首都的航空力量。机场建设限定在法兰西岛，保留原经验、建设上限与财政补助。
simp_chinese.SFP_reorganize_the_aviation_industry_des: 统筹巴黎本土的国有兵工与航空制造，两项原有生产建设均落在本省完整掌握的州。保留原军工数量、用地收益、容量限制与补助。
simp_chinese.SFP_agricultural_protectionism_desc: 以法兰西岛近郊耕地、批发市场和市区粮食采购保障居民供应。保留原供给政策精神。
simp_chinese.SFP_agricultural_collectivization_desc: 把法兰西岛工场与近郊粮食供应组织为生产合作社。原有民用建设和建筑槽限定于本省；保留合作社政策精神及原稳定度代价。
simp_chinese.SFP_nationalize_key_industry_desc: 将首都铁路、能源与关键工场纳入公共协调。保留低效经济改革：II改善为I，已有I时移除；已完成效率改革时获得50政治点数。
simp_chinese.SFP_stimulate_the_dynamic_market_desc: 依托巴黎采购市场与本省制造业，落实稳定订单和工业协作。保留原市场改革精神及生产效率收益。
simp_chinese.SFP_dirigisme_desc: 以统一采购和生产配额协调法兰西岛龙头企业。原有民用、军用工厂与用地建设限定在本省，保留统筹政策精神、容量限制和补助。
simp_chinese.SFP_public_welfare_desc: 整理巴黎本土的旧街区和住房用地，将公共福利落实到居民生活。为本省新增3个建筑槽，并获得10%稳定度。
simp_chinese.SFP_fusiliers_marine_desc: 以塞纳河渡河与复杂水岸作战为训练主题，培养首都部队的水陆协同能力。保留原两栖部队研究奖励。
simp_chinese.SFP_national_mobilization_desc: 协调巴黎本土的行政、工场和预备役，以本省资源实施动员。保留原动员精神与经济调整。
simp_chinese.SFP_national_regeneration_desc: 由巴黎政权确立新的政治秩序与执政方向，以首都治理作为其合法性基础。保留原政体选择及互斥路线。
simp_chinese.SFP_proclaim_the_third_empire_desc: 在巴黎宣布帝制立场，以首都为王朝政治的起点。此项宣言确立原有领导与政体路线；法国其他大区仍须通过后续外交或统一行动接入。
simp_chinese.SFP_naval_rearmament: 取得海岸后的舰队筹备
simp_chinese.SFP_naval_rearmament_desc: 巴黎本土位于内陆。实际拥有并完整控制法国沿海州之后，才能开展此项舰队筹备；新增船坞和海军用地仅落在取得的沿海州，保留原海军经验与内阁解锁。
simp_chinese.SFP_develop_colonial_dockyards_desc: 实际掌握海岸后，整备该沿海州的港口和船坞。港口、船坞及用地奖励均限定于完整拥有并控制的法国沿海州；保留原数量、上限与补助。
simp_chinese.SFP_the_old_school_desc: 实际掌握海岸后，集中建设已有港区的船坞产能。建设与用地收益全部落在完整拥有并控制的法国沿海州，保留原上限、补助和学说说明。
simp_chinese.SFP_the_young_school_desc: 实际掌握海岸后，以轻型舰艇设计与制造组织建立可负担的舰队方案。保留原研究奖励与舰队路线选择。
simp_chinese.SFP_rush_the_richelieus_desc: 实际掌握海岸后，组织重型舰艇的技术论证。保留原重舰研究奖励。
simp_chinese.SFP_carrier_focus_desc: 实际掌握海岸后，研究海上航空与舰队协同。保留原航母路线及研究奖励。
simp_chinese.SFP_carrier_planes_desc: 实际掌握海岸后，为海上航空准备舰载机设计。保留原舰载机研究奖励。
simp_chinese.SFP_prioritize_the_joffre_desc: 实际掌握海岸后，开展航母技术论证。保留原航母研究奖励与前置路线。
simp_chinese.SFP_undersea_combat_desc: 实际掌握海岸后，组织潜艇技术与战术研究。保留原潜艇路线和奖励。
simp_chinese.SFP_improved_screen_ships_desc: 实际掌握海岸后，组织护航舰艇研究与屏卫训练。保留原屏卫舰研究奖励。
simp_chinese.SFP_naval_doctrine_desc: 实际掌握海岸后，建立舰队指挥与海军训练制度。保留原海军学说奖励。
simp_chinese.sof_prs_local_home_control_tt: 拥有并完整控制至少一个法兰西岛本土州
simp_chinese.sof_prs_local_coastal_control_tt: 拥有并完整控制至少一个法国沿海州
simp_chinese.sof_van_prs_fra_global_investments_desc: 协调巴黎市区与本省近郊的公共采购和生产预算。具体修正见下方效果。
simp_chinese.sof_van_prs_fra_agricultural_protectioni: 协调本省近郊耕地、批发市场与首都粮食采购。具体修正见下方效果。
simp_chinese.sof_van_prs_fra_agricultural_collectiviz: 以合作社组织法兰西岛工场与近郊粮食供应。具体修正见下方效果。
simp_chinese.sof_van_prs_fra_dirigisme_desc: 以首都公共采购和生产配额协调本省制造企业。具体修正见下方效果。
simp_chinese.sof_hist_fra_maxime_weygand_requirements: 已完成以下国策之一：首都防御与阵地优先。
simp_chinese.sof_hist_fra_maurice_gamelin_requirement: 已完成以下国策之一：机动军与主动进攻优先。
simp_chinese.sof_hist_fra_louis_renault_requirements_: 已完成以下国策之一：巴黎制造业扩建。
simp_chinese.sof_hist_fra_francois_darlan_requirement: 已完成以下国策之一：取得海岸后的舰队筹备。
simp_chinese.sof_hist_fra_irene_joliot_curie_requirem: 已完成以下国策之一：巴黎大学与工程学校。
simp_chinese.sof_hist_fra_vincent_auriol_requirements: 已完成以下国策之一：首都财政清算。

english.SFP_devalue_the_franc_desc: Align municipal and suburban taxation, wages and procurement across Ile-de-France. Retains fiscal reform rewards and the treasury cabinet unlock.
english.SFP_autoroutes_desc: Improve one infrastructure level in an eligible fully owned and controlled Ile-de-France state. If all eligible roads are complete, gain 40 political power.
english.SFP_invest_in_the_metropole_desc: Coordinate public services, urban repairs and workshop recovery within Paris and its suburbs. Gain 5% stability.
english.SFP_metropolitan_france_desc: Redevelop unused warehouses and workshops to add two building slots within Ile-de-France.
english.SFP_algerie_france_desc: Renew industrial sites within Ile-de-France and add two local building slots.
english.SFP_invest_in_the_colonies_desc: Build one civilian factory and add one slot in an eligible fully owned and controlled Ile-de-France state. If capacity is exhausted, gain one 100% industry research bonus. Existing compliance improvements are limited to eligible home states.
english.SFP_invest_in_west_africa_desc: Consolidate three workshop and warehouse renewal stages along the Seine. Add a total of six building slots within Ile-de-France.
english.SFP_invest_in_syria_desc: Add two building slots within Ile-de-France.
english.SFP_invest_in_indochina_desc: Add two building slots within Ile-de-France.
english.SFP_industrial_expansion_desc: Add two building slots and build two civilian factories within Ile-de-France, retaining the original capacity limits and fiscal fallback.
english.SFP_colonial_industry_desc: Add one slot and build one civilian factory within Ile-de-France, retaining the original capacity limits and fiscal fallback.
english.SFP_military_factories_desc: Add a total of four slots and build two military factories within Ile-de-France, retaining the original capacity limits and fiscal fallback.
english.SFP_extra_research_slot_desc: Full ownership and control of Paris city, at least six factories and two research slots unlock slot three. If already at that slot count, gain one 100% electronics bonus.
english.SFP_extra_research_slot_2_desc: Full control of Paris city, at least twelve factories and three research slots, plus the preceding research expansion, unlock slot four. If already at that slot count, gain one 100% electronics bonus.
english.SFP_global_integration_desc: Align taxation, public procurement and production across Paris and its home province. Establish the coordinated capital budget spirit.
english.SFP_begin_rearmament_desc: Issue armament orders to home workshops. Construction and site rewards remain in fully owned and controlled Ile-de-France states, with existing limits and fallback rewards.
english.SFP_alpine_forts_desc: Coordinate methodical operations, fortification and capital security. Build forts in eligible home states, retaining doctrine discounts, defensive spirit, construction limits and fiscal fallback.
english.SFP_extend_the_maginot_line_desc: Extend the capital defence network within fully owned and controlled Ile-de-France states, retaining the original fort limits and fiscal fallback.
english.SFP_air_focus_desc: Prepare home airfields, flight training and maintenance to defend the capital. Airfield construction remains within Ile-de-France; experience, limits and fallback rewards are retained.
english.SFP_reorganize_the_aviation_industry_des: Coordinate the capital aviation and state-arsenal programmes. Both existing construction stages remain in fully owned and controlled home states, retaining factory quantities, slots, limits and fallback rewards.
english.SFP_agricultural_protectionism_desc: Coordinate home farmland, wholesale markets and municipal procurement to secure the capital food supply. Retains the existing supply-policy spirit.
english.SFP_agricultural_collectivization_desc: Organize home workshops and suburban food supply into cooperatives. Existing civilian construction and slots stay within Ile-de-France; the policy spirit and stability cost remain.
english.SFP_nationalize_key_industry_desc: Coordinate capital railways, energy and essential workshops. Inefficient Economy II improves to I, I is removed, and an already completed efficiency reform grants 50 political power.
english.SFP_stimulate_the_dynamic_market_desc: Use capital procurement and home manufacturing to support stable orders and industrial coordination. Retains the original market spirit and production-efficiency benefits.
english.SFP_dirigisme_desc: Coordinate home manufacturers through procurement and production plans. Existing civilian and military construction and slots stay within Ile-de-France, with original policy spirit, limits and fallback rewards.
english.SFP_public_welfare_desc: Renew housing and urban sites within the home province. Add three building slots and gain 10% stability.
english.SFP_fusiliers_marine_desc: Train capital troops for Seine crossings and difficult waterfront operations. Retains the existing amphibious research rewards.
english.SFP_national_mobilization_desc: Coordinate the home administration, workshops and reserves. Retains the original mobilization spirit and economic adjustments.
english.SFP_national_regeneration_desc: Reorganize the Paris government around capital administration. Retains the original government transition and exclusive political route.
english.SFP_proclaim_the_third_empire_desc: Proclaim the imperial route from Paris. Retains the existing leadership and government changes; other French regions still require subsequent diplomacy or unification.
english.SFP_naval_rearmament_desc: Paris begins inland. This programme requires a fully owned and controlled French coastal state. Dockyards and naval sites are added only on the acquired coast; naval experience and the cabinet unlock are retained.
english.SFP_develop_colonial_dockyards_desc: Requires a fully owned and controlled French coast. Existing port, dockyard and site rewards apply only to acquired coastal states, with original quantities, limits and fallback rewards.
english.SFP_the_old_school_desc: Requires a fully owned and controlled French coast. Dockyard construction and sites stay on acquired coastal states; original limits, fallback rewards and doctrine notes remain.
english.SFP_the_young_school_desc: After acquiring a fully controlled French coast, develop an affordable light fleet. Retains original research rewards and fleet-route choices.
english.SFP_rush_the_richelieus_desc: Requires an acquired, fully controlled French coast. Retains the original heavy-ship research rewards.
english.SFP_carrier_focus_desc: Requires an acquired, fully controlled French coast. Retains the carrier route and its research rewards.
english.SFP_carrier_planes_desc: Requires an acquired, fully controlled French coast. Retains carrier-aircraft research rewards.
english.SFP_prioritize_the_joffre_desc: Requires an acquired, fully controlled French coast. Retains carrier research rewards and prerequisites.
english.SFP_undersea_combat_desc: Requires an acquired, fully controlled French coast. Retains submarine research and route rewards.
english.SFP_improved_screen_ships_desc: Requires an acquired, fully controlled French coast. Retains escort-ship research rewards.
english.SFP_naval_doctrine_desc: Requires an acquired, fully controlled French coast. Retains naval-doctrine rewards.
english.sof_prs_local_home_control_tt: Own and fully control at least one home state in Ile-de-France
english.sof_prs_local_coastal_control_tt: Own and fully control at least one French coastal state
english.sof_van_prs_fra_global_investments_desc: Coordinate procurement and production budgets across Paris and its home province. Modifiers are shown below.
english.sof_van_prs_fra_agricultural_protectioni: Coordinate home farmland, wholesale markets and capital food procurement. Modifiers are shown below.
english.sof_van_prs_fra_agricultural_collectiviz: Organize Ile-de-France workshops and suburban food supply through cooperatives. Modifiers are shown below.
english.sof_van_prs_fra_dirigisme_desc: Coordinate home manufacturers through capital procurement and production plans. Modifiers are shown below.
english.sof_hist_fra_maurice_gamelin_requirement: Completed Mobile Army and Offensive Priority.
english.sof_hist_fra_francois_darlan_requirement: Completed Fleet Preparation after Coastal Acquisition.
english.sof_hist_fra_irene_joliot_curie_requirem: Completed Paris Universities and Engineering Schools.

preserved: All focus IDs, layout, prerequisites, exclusions, costs, native quantities/caps, research thresholds, old claim flags and cross-regional diplomatic targets.
save_compatibility: No migration or retroactive rewards. Existing completed focuses keep their claim flags; incomplete focuses use updated eligibility and construction scopes on a newly loaded tree. Old-save execution needs campaign testing.
